known.via: English Wikipedia "Condado de Huelva (DO)" (redirects to "Condado de Huelva")

blurb.text: An Andalusia appellation in the south-east of Huelva province, covering about 14,800 acres and 18 municipalities. Its wines are known as the Wines of the Discovery of America. Rules allow still and liqueur wines from Zalema, Palomino Fino, Pedro Ximénez and Moscatel.
